name: spatial-tracking
description: Breadcrumb GPS trail + barometric altitude tracker (web PWA + Capacitor Android app)

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android
scripts.android:assemble: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:dev: npm run build:web && node scripts/cap-dev.mjs && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run sync && cap open android
